exposure: models of care (dedicated GDM obstetric clinics, routine antenatal care/non-dedicated clinics)
cohort: The study included all births between 1 January 2018 and 30 November 2020 at a tertiary referral centre, excluding births <24 weeks, multiple gestations, and women with pre-existing diabetes.
finding: Women with GDM, particularly those attending non-dedicated clinics, experienced higher rates of adverse outcomes such as HDP, PTB, OASIS, and NICU admission compared to non-GDM women or GDM women in dedicated clinics.
mod_finding: Women with GDM attending non-dedicated clinics had similar odds of induction of labour compared with non-GDM women.
birth_weight: SGA and LGA categories were outcomes, but specific birth weight ranges for included babies were not mentioned.
gest_age: Births <24 weeks gestational age were excluded from the study, and pre-term birth was an outcome.
